The rain slammed down on the asphalt of the alley, nearly flooding with the downpour. Mist filled the air between the glass buildings, billowing in the howling wind whipping the power lines like twine. Squeaking in protest on its hinges the front door to Charlies Bar slowly opens into what could be called the daylight, smoke greeting the mist as a man pushes his way drunkenly into the wet air.

“Ssstupid fuken door.” He slurs, with a slight stumble. Reaching into his coat pocket he fishes about frustrated finally producing a silver lighter and a packet of cigarettes labeled “SMOOTH MENTHOL” in bright green letters. Teasing one out and getting it to his lips, he stuffs the packet away. “Goddamned rain, fuck me.” He grumbles sobering in the cold rather quickly, lighting his cigarette and making his way down the rainy street something catches his attention.

Its a noise, not sure what he stops taking a long draw, and slowly exhaling attempting to blow smoke rings in the ever constant wind to no avail. Sirens?

“Nah, what the fuck is that?” he wonders aloud stomping out his smoke, and cupping his ear with his open hand.

“Screaming?” now suddenly aware he's speaking to himself. No thats not screaming.

Then before he can think anymore a small bright red car come careening around the corner by the bar, tires squealing and steaming with heat on the wet street. Plumes of mist and water stream behind the car as it slides towards him. Stunned the man can't react fast enough and just stands agape. With one mighty screech the car comes to a halt mere inches from the man.

“Hey asshole, the fuck'sh wrong with you?!” He yells at the driver in shock. “You coulda killed a guy!”

Clicking the drivers door opens and a woman's voice says “Either goddamn move, or hop in buddy. I'm kinda real fuckin' busy.”

“What? The fuck d'you mean get in? You just about fuckin' killed me!” he exclaims exasperated.

“Busy!” she states and slams the door shut.

“Fuck!” he screamed at the sky, grabbing for the door handle and swinging open the passenger door, plopping into the black leather seats and closing the door in a fluid motion. He starts to fish in his pockets once again.

“Whats yer name fella?” the driver asks as he lights his smoke and then a second.

“Call me Chuck.” handing her one of the cigarettes. “you?” he asks cracking the window open an inch.

“Betty, what you doin' out in the rain? You ain't got a car?” she asks as she starts to drive again, at the same manic pace.

“I was just getting outta the bar when you just about fuckin' ran me down” he mutters flicking ashes out the window. “Why you drivin so crazy, doll? Slow it down a little, you'll live longer.”

Pointing into the back seat she looks at Chuck without saying a word.

Bags, leather duffel bags?

“What the hell am I lookin at?”

“open It up and find out” she says stubbing out her cigarette in the cars ashtray.

Pulling one of the bags closer to him as he turned about in his seat, he unzipped a bag spilling out wads of cash.

It’s not a secret that the icon pack that Microsoft introduced in Windows 10 build 9926 was heavily criticized by users across the world, and in order to tweak the operating system so that it better tackles customer feedback, the software giant has recently rolled out updated icons that make the desktop feel more modern and fresh.

And now Microsoft can’t seem to stop, as the recently leaked build 10147 that reached the web a few hours ago comes with even more updated icons that are available in the Start menu.

Previously, Microsoft focused exclusively on the desktop icons, but with this new release, its attention is turned to the Start menu icons and live tiles.

New File Explorer icon

As Microsoft watcher Richard Hay writes, build 10147 includes updated File Explorer and All apps icons, as well as several changes to the icons used for Modern apps.

For example, the Videos app, which has been renamed to Movies & TV, comes with a fresh icon that better expresses the purpose of the app. Renaming Videos to Movies just makes sense because, in Windows 10, the Store will provide access to movies and TV shows, so this app would allow you to watch content that you previously purchased from the store.

There’s also a new icon for the Mail app, but also for Maps, so Microsoft spent a little bit more time to improve the look of more Modern app. This trend is expected to continue in the coming builds, as we approach the debut of the final version of Windows 10.

Another change that’s included in this build allows users to simply drag live tiles from the Start menu to the desktop to create shortcuts and launch them faster. This way, the icons that you see in the Start menu will be used on the desktop too, hence the increased interest in making them look better.

As usual, user feedback is a decisive factor for Windows 10, so in case you don’t like the new icons, just make yourself heard and Microsoft could replace them before the final version launches.
